mechanism_narrative: The strong and increasing PARKS mobility, reaching 26.7% above baseline at t-0w, indicates a general increase in out-of-home leisure activities that will spill over into retail and recreation as people extend their outings, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility exceeds 25% above baseline in the current week (t-0w).
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not show an improvement in its weekly mean over the next two weeks despite PARKS mobility remaining above 25%.

failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility continues its upward trend, but RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days.
